sections.name: What is Surface?
text:
Surface is a small format for describing an application.

It records what the application should contain without choosing an implementation framework.

sections.name: Is Surface a programming language?
text: No. Surface is a specification format rather than an executable language.

sections.name: Does every screen need a route?
text:
No. Add a route when a screen has a URL or similar address.

Leave it out for screens that are not addressable.
